videoDetails.title: The FBI Agent Who Infiltrated the Mafia
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Epidemic Sound has been part of our toolkit for years. If you want to try it yourself, click on our link and use code fern60 at checkout to get 60% off for 2 months: https://share.epidemicsound.com/fernSEP26 
*Offer valid until Oct 15th (ad)

Join our newsletter: https://roots.watchfern.com/

This is the story about Donnie Brasco, the undercover agent who infiltrated the New York Mafia.

Much of this video is based on Joe Pistone’s own accounts of his time undercover, particularly his books:
Donnie Brasco: My Undercover Life in the Mafia https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Donnie+Brasco+My+Undercover+Life+in+the+Mafia+Joe+Pistone
The Way of the Wise Guy https://www.amazon.com/s?k=The+Way+of+the+Wise+Guy+Joe+Pistone
Donnie Brasco: Unfinished Business https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Donnie+Brasco+Unfinished+Business+Joe+Pistone

For more, listen to Deep Cover: The Real Donnie Brasco by Jam Street Media:
https://open.spotify.com/show/3Mf4oliHd7xlfB3LNn0ym4?si=9775aba2ebfd44ff

Corrections:
0:17 'Willwaukee' is a typo, but fern does acknowledge and celebrate the strong will of the good people of Wisconsin. Go Pack!
